window_start_min.label: Evening starts at
window_start_min.note: Modelling choice: the simulated evening starts at 18:00. Only affects the clock shown, not the results.

arrival_window_min.label: Arrival window
arrival_window_min.note: Assumes walk-ins from 18:00; ends at last orders, midnight (user interview). Start time is a modelling choice.

close_after_last_orders_min.label: Last orders to close
close_after_last_orders_min.note: User: orders stop at 12, bar closes 1 AM. Register D5 also says till 1 AM.

arrival_rate_per_hour.label: Walk-in arrival profile
arrival_rate_per_hour.note: No arrival counts exist for Khar. Shape is a modelling choice: a mid-evening peak. Vary with arrival_scale.

arrival_scale.label: Arrival rate multiplier
arrival_scale.note: Scales the whole arrival profile. Range is illustrative.

party_size_pmf.label: Party-size mix
party_size_pmf.note: No party-size data. Modelling choice; the one Khar walk-in observed was a party of 6-7.

outdoor_4tops.label: Outdoor four-seat tables
outdoor_4tops.note: Indicative count from the user's rough floor plan (2026-11-14). Parties do not share a table, so a small party can occupy a long one.

outdoor_2tops.label: Outdoor two-seat tables
outdoor_2tops.note: Indicative count from the user's rough floor plan (2026-11-14). Parties do not share a table, so a small party can occupy a long one.

hall_8tops.label: Indoor eight-seat tables
hall_8tops.note: Indicative count from the user's rough floor plan (2026-11-14). Parties do not share a table, so a small party can occupy a long one.

hall_6tops.label: Indoor six-seat tables, back
hall_6tops.note: Indicative count from the user's rough floor plan (2026-11-14). Parties do not share a table, so a small party can occupy a long one.

lower_6tops.label: Indoor six-seat tables, street side
lower_6tops.note: Indicative count from the user's rough floor plan (2026-11-14). Parties do not share a table, so a small party can occupy a long one.

allow_table_join.label: Join tables for large parties
allow_table_join.note: User's booked party of 18 had tables joined (visit-log row 2). Assumed to apply to walk-ins within one zone.

balk_per_queued_party.label: Balk probability per party already waiting
balk_per_queued_party.note: No balking data. Linear in queue length, capped at 1. Range is illustrative.

patience_median_min.label: Median patience while waiting
patience_median_min.note: Assumption. Sanity check only: one Khar walk-in waited about 30 min and was seated (visit-log row 1). Not calibrated.

dwell_median_min.label: Median time at table
dwell_median_min.note: No table-turn data for Khar. Range is illustrative.

A_balk_mult.label: Waitlist: balking multiplier
A_balk_mult.note: Baek 2018 (abstract) supports the direction only: point estimates reduce balking. Size is assumed; upper bound 1 means no effect.

A_patience_mult.label: Waitlist: patience multiplier
A_patience_mult.note: Aksin et al. 2025 (abstract) supports the direction only: progress information reduces reneging. Size is assumed; lower bound 1 means no effect.

B_lounge_capacity.label: Wait lounge capacity
B_lounge_capacity.note: No lounge exists in the sketch (ASSUMED LAYOUT). Whether serving in a waiting area is permitted is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE (R8).

B_lounge_conversion.label: Share of waiting parties who order in the lounge
B_lounge_conversion.note: No data. Dishoom (E5) is an analogue for serving waiting guests, not a measured rate.

B_lounge_patience_mult.label: Lounge: patience multiplier
B_lounge_patience_mult.note: Assumed that an occupied wait is tolerated longer. No effect size in any source; lower bound 1 means no effect.

B_pour_spend.label: Lounge spend per person
B_pour_spend.note: Insufficient evidence: no sourced price for a small pour at Khar. Enter a value to see lounge revenue.

C_takeaway_share.label: Share of walk-aways who buy takeaway
C_takeaway_share.note: No data. Takeaway at Khar is unverified on platforms (D3). Range is illustrative.

C_litres_per_order.label: Litres per takeaway order
C_litres_per_order.note: Assumed one 1 L pack, the pack size in D1. Range spans the growler sizes in E2.

C_price_per_litre.label: Takeaway price per litre
C_price_per_litre.note: Historical/analogue, undated: Doolally 'from Rs 500' per litre (D1, outlet and date unknown) and Effingut Rs 499 (E2, 2020). Khar availability unverified. Range is illustrative.

dinein_spend_per_two.label: Dine-in spend for two
dinein_spend_per_two.note: CONFLICT between platforms; middle candidate used as the value, revenue is reported as a band across all candidates.

stepout_share.label: Share of seated parties with a smoke or phone step-out
stepout_share.note: No evidence for this figure; off by default (0). Range is illustrative. Logged against a seated party; the table is kept and time at table does not change.

washroom_share.label: Share of seated parties with a washroom trip
washroom_share.note: No evidence for this figure; off by default (0). Range is illustrative. Logged against a seated party; the table is kept and time at table does not change.

remake_share.label: Share of seated parties with a wrong-order remake
remake_share.note: No evidence for this figure; off by default (0). Range is illustrative. Logged against a seated party; adds the remake delay to that party's time at table.

remake_delay_min.label: Extra time at table after a wrong-order remake
remake_delay_min.note: No evidence for this figure; off by default (0). Range is illustrative. Has no effect unless the remake share is above 0.
